entries.title: Notion
entries.summary: Keep notes, prepare meetings and turn ideas into documents.
entries.requirements: Browser sign-in to Notion. Its account and service limits apply.

entries.title: Todoist
entries.summary: Find, create and organise tasks in Todoist.
entries.requirements: Browser sign-in to Todoist. Its account and service limits apply.

entries.title: Linear
entries.summary: Work with issues, projects and team plans in Linear.
entries.requirements: Browser sign-in to Linear. Its account and service limits apply.

entries.title: Canva
entries.summary: Create and revise designs, resize them and work through feedback.
entries.requirements: Browser sign-in to Canva. Some features need a paid Canva plan.

entries.title: Dropbox
entries.summary: Find, inspect, organise and share your Dropbox files.
entries.requirements: Browser sign-in to Dropbox. Its account and service limits apply.

entries.title: Context7
entries.summary: Look up current documentation for programming libraries and frameworks.
entries.requirements: Public lookups work without signing in. Internet access and Context7's service limits apply.

entries.title: Anti-AI Writing
entries.summary: Review and revise formulaic English and Spanish drafts.
entries.requirements: Works in chat with the included editing guides. No extra account is needed.

entries.title: Obsidian Markdown
entries.summary: Draft notes with Obsidian wikilinks, properties and callouts.
entries.requirements: Writing notes into an existing vault needs write access to that folder.

entries.title: JSON Canvas
entries.summary: Write .canvas files with nodes and the connections between them.
entries.requirements: Saving a .canvas file needs write access to its folder. Open it in Obsidian or another JSON Canvas viewer.
